- Now we can stick AI on everything, even a toothbrush. I am not sure AI toothbrushes should be a separate field, but geospatial AI definitely is.

- Spatial reasoning is not really there - it's more like memorized maps for now (GIS people still have a job).

- I believe the biggest bottleneck in AI today is that the models are moving much faster than good quality training data is catching up - except those we generate by using apps and tech companies gate-keep.

Today, Cloudera is announcing Cloudera for Digital Sovereignty, giving organizations more choice and control over where their data, models and workloads live and run.

As digital sovereignty becomes an increasingly important consideration for enterprise AI, Cloudera is helping customers build and deploy AI with the flexibility, control and governance they need.

Learn more: https://www.cloudera.com/about/news-and-blogs/press-releases/2026-11-24-cloudera-launches-digital-sovereignty-solution-that-gives-enterprises-control-of-data-and-ai-across-the-entire-lifecycle.html  Facebook

NADRA invites applications from experienced professionals with expertise in data analytics, business intelligence, and enterprise data management for the position of 𝗗𝗶𝗿𝗲𝗰𝘁𝗼𝗿 (𝗗𝗮𝘁𝗮 𝗔𝗻𝗮𝗹𝘆𝘁𝗶𝗰𝘀 & 𝗩𝗶𝘀𝘂𝗮𝗹𝗶𝘇𝗮𝘁𝗶𝗼𝗻). 
The role focuses on leading data analytics and BI initiatives, developing dashboards and executive reports, and delivering data-driven insights. 
Proficiency in Oracle, Teradata, SQL, Python/R, Tableau, Power BI, data warehousing, ETL/ELT, and predictive analytics is highly relevant.
An opportunity to lead enterprise analytics initiatives at NADRA’s National Data Warehouse and support informed decision-making through data.
📍 Location: Islamabad
📅 Deadline: 29th November, 2026
🔗 Apply through the official Careers Portal: careers.nadra.gov.pk
NADRA is an equal opportunity employer and encourages all eligible candidates to apply.
